subject: Private deployment — timezone & compliance intake for Wellbridge demo

Subject: Demo request — private deployment (healthcare)

We saw Redwood in the marketplace and completed the self-serve sign-up indicating interest in Private/VPC deployment for a regulated healthcare workload. We need a focused technical demo with our infra and security leads to cover network requirements, data residency, and compliance posture.

Attaching our initial network worksheet (Network_Requirements.xlsx) and a short vendor security questionnaire.

Attendees:
 - Hannah Turner — Product (me)
 - Mark Simons — Infrastructure
 - Priya Rao — Security (will loop in after times)

We prefer mornings PST next week (Dec 7–10). Can you share availability and SOC 2 / security docs we can review ahead of time? Also please include the person who will demo the on-prem/VPC install path.

Thanks,
Hannah

Quick answers up front:
- SOC 2 summary: attached (SOC2_summary.pdf).
- Demo owner: Neha (cc'd) will lead the technical walkthrough and cover on-prem and VPC options.

Proposed slots (PST):
1) Tue Dec 8 — 10:00–10:45 AM PST
2) Wed Dec 9 — 9:00–9:45 AM PST

Can you confirm which slot works and whether Mark + Priya will join? Also, please attach the vendor questionnaire if you have it filled out; I can route answers and a short network checklist to your infra lead.

- Neha will prepare a 10-minute deep-dive on firewall/egress and data isolation.

Best,

Wed Dec 9 at 9:00 AM PST works for us. Mark will attend and I will confirm Priya by end of day. I've attached our partially-completed vendor security questionnaire so you can see the items we're tracking (Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.docx).

If you could add these to the agenda that would be great. Please include a calendar invite once confirmed.

Thanks,
Hannah

Agenda (30–45 mins):
1) 5 min — intros and goals (Hannah, Mark, Priya if present)
2) 10 min — Neha: architecture options (VPC vs on-prem) + kernel of network/firewall config
3) 10 min — demo: private deployment flow + data residency and KV cache handling
4) 5–10 min — Q&A and next steps (SLA, PoC sequencing, required artifacts)

Notes / asks for your team before demo:
- Please confirm Priya's availability; if she can't make it, send any throttling & retention questions in advance.
- Mark: if you can attach a short diagram of your VPC topology (optional) that will help us prep.

Neha — can you prepare the Splunk/logging slide and a short firewall port table?
Rishi — flagging for potential SLA/contract questions after demo (we may want to schedule a follow-up with pricing).

Thanks all — calendar invite and meeting materials are in the invite. Looking forward to it.
